- Shape: `Part of #33851` (the card closed with PR #33979, merged). Draft, base `main`, one file, +1/−1. `check-governed-merges --pr 34017`: NOT governed.
- DELIBERATE CORRECTION confirmed (landing-operations: a diff that edits only release text is confirmed by the dispatching seat's ACCEPT, quoting each rewritten sentence). Note: `.changeset/33563-revert-commit-honest-outcome.md` (pending, from PR #33805).
  - Before: "A write-through fault the registry helper only logs (every metadata type other than `object`) is still not seen by the revert."
  - After: "The same holds for an item of any other metadata type: a restored item whose registry write-through throws, and a removed item whose registry heal stops, so that the registry may still serve the removed row."
  - Checked against merged PR #33979 (Fixes #33851): `revertCommit`'s restore limb reads the non-object write-through fault (`answerFaults`), and its soft-remove limb reads the heal's `RegistryHealStop`. Both put the item in `failed[]` with `success: false`. The old sentence became false when #33979 merged, and the new one says what landed. Nothing else in the note changes.
- Gates: 43 check-runs on this head: 22 success, 20 expected skip, and 1 red by design, `Check Changeset`. Its own log says to leave it red: "if its only .changeset rows are CHANGED, not added, this PR corrects somebody else's pending release note -- do NOT apply 'skip-changeset'; write the confirmation on the PR … and leave this check red (#18375)". It runs only on `pull_request` (`.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml`, no `merge_group` trigger), and it is not a required check. This comment records the gate and the cause. All three conditions of SKILL.md's red-by-design rule hold, so the PR queues with that check red.
- Changeset: none added (a correction of a pending note, by design). No `skip-changeset` label.
